bundle.shortDescription: GUI markdown reader with a highlight-to-agent loop
bundle.longDescription: dreamd renders the markdown in your repository with real typography in its own window. Highlight passages, attach questions, and send the stack to your agent in one action. Read-only: it never writes to your markdown.
